pages.text: A gene goes into a serum once your library has it read to 30%: a $(item)Draft$(). Each auto-read of a $(item)DNA Fraction$() at the $(item)DNA Sequencer$() adds 15% of the fraction's quality, shared among its creature's genes. A quality-80 fraction of a one-gene creature adds 12%: three reads to a Draft. A two-gene creature takes five. Calling the bases yourself reads up to 25% of the quality, so fewer. A fraction's tooltip counts the reads for you.
Creatures not listed here (a cow, a pig, a sheep, a zombie) carry nothing readable: their fractions say so. The pages that follow list every gene and who carries it.
